_meta.origin: original TypeScript exports evaluated through esbuild; no tuning invented
_meta.warning: Data equality does not imply Godot behavior or visual parity. Function effects must be ported and tested.

assaultRifle.name: M4 Turret
assaultRifle.desc: Accurate automatic rifle fire for infantry and light vehicles.

akTurret.name: AK Battle Station
akTurret.desc: Hard-hitting automatic fire with a fast cyclic rate.

bazooka.name: Bazooka Pod
bazooka.desc: Direct-fire anti-armor rockets with heavy splash damage.

grenadeLauncher.name: Grenade Launcher
grenadeLauncher.desc: Arcing grenades clear dense infantry groups.

minigun.name: M134 Minigun
minigun.desc: Extreme sustained fire for drones, bikes, and infantry.

railgun.name: Coil Railgun
railgun.desc: Long-range electromagnetic sabot with massive single-target damage.

missileRack.name: Guided Missile Rack
missileRack.desc: Guided rockets for armored vehicles and heavy drones.

workshop.name: Field Repair Bay
workshop.desc: Patches hull integrity every four seconds.

armor.name: Composite Armor
armor.desc: +55 maximum integrity and stronger collision resistance.

treasury.name: Logistics Locker
treasury.desc: +15% value from every collected salvage part.

bumper.name: Assault Ram
bumper.desc: Shoves hostile armored vehicles and amplifies impact damage.

radar.name: Radar Array
radar.desc: Detects nearby enemies. Upgrade coverage: 40 / 90 / 160 / 260 m.

counterDroneJammer.name: Counter-Drone Jammer
counterDroneJammer.desc: Within 32m, enemy drones move and fire at 55% rate; kamikaze drones cannot detonate.

levelUpgrades.title: High-Flow Turbo
levelUpgrades.desc: Top speed and acceleration increase by 14%.

levelUpgrades.title: Racing Transmission
levelUpgrades.desc: Top speed and acceleration increase by 10%.

levelUpgrades.title: Nitro Calibration
levelUpgrades.desc: Gain 8% speed and recover nitro 18% faster.

levelUpgrades.title: Salvage Rush
levelUpgrades.desc: Gain 55 coins and increase future coin value by 10%.

levelUpgrades.title: Plow Momentum
levelUpgrades.desc: Ram cooldown is reduced by 28%, while Road Fury combo grace lasts longer and momentum decays slower.

levelUpgrades.title: Fire Control Officer
levelUpgrades.desc: Every weapon gains 12% range and 12% damage.

levelUpgrades.title: Overdrive Feed
levelUpgrades.desc: Moving above half speed grants 16% faster firing.

levelUpgrades.title: Targeting Computer
levelUpgrades.desc: All equipped weapons gain 18% targeting range.

levelUpgrades.title: Emergency Nanoweld
levelUpgrades.desc: Slowly regenerate integrity while below 35% health.

levelUpgrades.title: Twin Feed Mechanism
levelUpgrades.desc: Every weapon has a 16% chance to fire a second reduced-damage shot.

levelUpgrades.title: Fire Suppression
levelUpgrades.desc: Reduce damage taken while integrity is below 30%.

levelUpgrades.title: Expanded Weapon Rack
levelUpgrades.desc: Increase crawler weapon capacity by one, up to six guns. The sixth slot requires LV 4.

armor.title: Armor
armor.description: Raises maximum integrity and damage resistance, but adds weight.

fuel.title: Fuel system
fuel.description: Raises tank capacity and reduces fuel consumption.

WALKER_TRAILER_DEFINITION.name: Walker Trailer
WALKER_TRAILER_DEFINITION.description: Adds three stable module mounts. Its walking frame adds weight and raises fuel use by 12%.

breachCrew.name: Breach Crew
breachCrew.description: A charged ram breaches one ordinary PvE vehicle or structure for 6s. Its next explosive hit deals 35% more damage.

targetRelay.name: Target Relay
targetRelay.description: Focusing a local target marks it for 8s. The next railgun or missile-rack hit consumes the mark for 40% bonus PvE pierce damage.

salvageLoop.name: Salvage Loop
salvageLoop.description: Offline PvE only. Collected salvage charges a 20-point reserve. At full charge, missing integrity triggers a 30-point repair pulse instead of the locker value bonus.

suppressionCycle.name: Suppression Cycle
suppressionCycle.description: Rapid ballistic hits build up to 5 suppression for 2.5s. A grenade consumes it to interrupt ordinary PvE targets for up to 0.65s.

combinedFeed.name: Combined Feed
combinedFeed.description: Alternating ballistic and explosive PvE hits within 4s primes one bonus local-PvE shot. The opportunity expires after 3s and never changes PvP cadence.

stormConductor.name: Storm Conductor
stormConductor.description: A railgun hit on a wet local PvE target chains once to the nearest valid wet NPC within 14m for 45% damage.

fragmentation-shells.name: Fragmentation Shells
fragmentation-shells.tradeoff: +30% PvE blast radius; -18% PvE targeting range.

penetrator-sabots.name: Penetrator Sabots
penetrator-sabots.tradeoff: Pierces 1 additional PvE target; -20% PvE damage per target.

concussion-rounds.name: Concussion Rounds
concussion-rounds.tradeoff: Slows PvE targets by 25% for 1.5s; -18% PvE damage.

break-the-line.title: Break the Line
break-the-line.description: Destroy 3 raider foundries across any runs.

mixed-battery.title: Mixed Battery
mixed-battery.description: Fire weapons from 2 projectile families in one run.

powder-dry.title: Keep the Powder Dry
powder-dry.description: Finish a run lasting at least 3 minutes without firing a rocket-family weapon.

bad-weather-work.title: Bad Weather Work
bad-weather-work.description: Complete 1 world activity during rain or a storm.

combined-arms.title: Combined Arms
combined-arms.description: Win a run with an M4 Turret and Bazooka Pod installed.
